name: opencode-muse-provider
description: Muse Code subscription provider and OpenCode V2 plugin

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/plugin.ts --target=node --format=esm --external @opencode/plugin --outfile dist/muse-code-1.4.14-r4/server.js
scripts.test: npm run build && tsx tests/muse-provider.test.ts && tsx tests/tool-descriptions.test.ts && tsx tests/tool-alias.test.ts
